notes.title: Update 0.2.6 is here with first bugfixes!
notes.content:
[h2]First Demo update! [/h2]


[h3]We hope you are having fun with the game so far! We are working on the development all the time and has just released our first update during the Steam Next Fest.
 [/h3]


[h3]In the 0.2.6 version we've:
[list]
[*] Moved fragments of keys on 2 altars to reduce the chance of a softlock (blocking oneself from proceeding in the game by playing in a different, not predicted by the creators, way)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to get stuck on the puzzle in front of the village
[*] Done some other minor fixes
[/list][/h3]


[b][h3]If you have any feedback, or just want to share your experience with the game, join our community on Discord 💖 We would love to see you there![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841678/6261c9b26ed61a7005e0ab72f573b31631944b0a.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Next Fest is here and Narru will be one of the games with its demo available during the Fest! 🥳[/h2]

What to expect? Well, in the demo, you will:x

🎯 Experience the unique atmosphere of the Forgotten Lands while exploring breathtaking gardens, underground ruins, and an old village. 🏞️ 

🎯 Solve different types of puzzles, while there will be much more of them in the full game 🧩 

🎯 Paint all the three locations with life and flowers by moving, solving the puzzles, and using ancient keys to unveil the mystery of the island 🧩 

[h3] We count on your feedback! [/h3]

Join our Discord community and share your thoughts on the demo with the devs! we would really appreciate it 💖[h3][url=https://discord.gg/tzcDcfsE88]
Join us on Discord[/url][/h3]

We hope that you will enjoy Narru’s demo as much as we enjoyed making it. 🥰



If you want to see more updates on the game, follow us also on [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/NarruTheForgottenLands]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/NarruGame]Twitter [/url]💌

notes.title: We are working on a playable demo!
notes.content:
[h2]What's it all about?[/h2]

Some of you may wonder what we are doing all this time 🤔 Well, right now we’re fixing bugs and checking details in Narru demo, making sure to give you the best experience possible!

[h2]What can you expect in our demo? [/h2]

You will:
🎯 get to know a bit about the world of Narru and its secrets
🎯 experience the unique atmosphere of the Forgotten Lands
🎯 have a sneak peak of puzzles we prepared for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841678/e149cae6f29d550dad48cff753693282054155ae.gif[/img]

[h2]Want to know more? Ask anything? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/tzcDcfsE88]Discord![/url][/h2]

If you would like to have all the important updates and see WIP materials before anyone else, feel free to join our Discord channel and have a chat with our community queen (yes, that's me 😏), our devs, and other community members 👉 https://discord.gg/tzcDcfsE88

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841678/6261c9b26ed61a7005e0ab72f573b31631944b0a.png[/img]

notes.title: You can now join Narru's community on Discord!
notes.content:
[h3]First, thank you all for your support![/h3]

We are so glad there is so many of you in the wishlists and on our social media. We've gathered a pretty decent community now, so we'd like to give you all a place to communicate and get to know us and each other!

And that's how Narru's Discord server has been created :D  Let's make a great place together!


[h2]Click [url=https://discord.gg/tzcDcfsE88]HERE[/url] to join our Discord![/h2]


It's a safe space for all the players to have a chat with the devs and other wonderful people in the community. Support each other, ask questions, air your expectations about the game, and follow the development and latest updates :)

There is also a lot of space for other topics so you can talk about anything you want. Wanna show us your art? Sure! Want to talk about how your dog tried to eat your shoelaces? no problem! We all just want to have fun and create a nice and comfy place to chat. Feel free to join us :D


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41841678/5eb2798aac6bdccb4caf057359a43ab41a1ce5d4.png[/img]
